proposals.summary: Add a transfer-hold at rail stops for imminent train arrivals and a queue-relief hold at Old Main, keeping the baseline 2/2/2 allocation and terminal headway rule.
proposals.rationale: The champion misses 633 connections and leaves 1,863 riders behind, with the worst pain at Old Main (232 left behind on r3, 93 on r1) and Central Station (94 riders arriving from the train just after r2 left). A short, bounded hold at rail-paired stops when a train is imminent and transfers are expected should capture those connections, while a queue-relief hold at Old Main when the local queue is large lets the bus fill before departing. Both holds are capped well under the 15-minute service-gap limit and reuse the existing 2/2/2 allocation so no route is starved. Changes: Add rule hold-for-train: hold up to 40 s at a rail-paired stop when train_eta_s <= 60 and expected_transfers >= 6 and headway_behind_s >= 120; Add rule old-main-relief: hold up to 30 s at Old Main when queue_here >= 25 and headway_behind_s >= 180; Keep baseline allocation 2/2/2, maxHoldS 60, train dwell 45 s, and the even-headway terminal rule.

proposals.summary: Keep 2/2/2 buses and terminal headway hold, but add a bounded stop-level spacing hold for early buses facing queues, plus a queue-relief hold at Old Main.
proposals.rationale: The champion leaves 232 Route 3 riders behind at Old Main and 94 train-to-Route-2 transfers miss their connection at Central. The terminal-only headway rule cannot correct bunching once buses are already in the loop, so a short stop-level hold (only when a bus is far ahead of its target headway and a queue is present) should even out gaps without delaying many onboard riders. A second, very narrow hold at Old Main when its queue is large and the next bus is still far away directly attacks the worst bottleneck while staying within the 180 s per-loop budget. Changes: Add stop-level spacing rule: hold up to 25 s when headway_ratio < 0.6 and queue_here >= 15; Add Old Main queue-relief rule: hold up to 40 s when queue_here >= 60 and headway_behind_s >= 240; Keep 2/2/2 allocation, maxHoldS 60, and the existing terminal even-headway rule.

proposals.summary: Rebalance to 2/3/1 buses for the apartment-heavy surges and reassign idle Route 3 buses to the busiest route at terminals.
proposals.rationale: Findings show the worst left-behind queues are on Routes 2 and 3, especially apartment-bound riders and Old Main/Stadium transfers. The baseline 2/2/2 split starves Route 2 during stadium_exit, while Route 3 runs 96% empty in class_change. Shifting one bus from r3 to r2 and letting idle r3 buses reassign to the busiest queue should cut pass-minutes without creating long gaps, since each route keeps at least one bus and reassignment only moves buses at terminals. Changes: Allocation changed from 2/2/2 to 2/3/1 to match apartment and stadium ridership; Add a terminal reassignment rule: idle r3 buses move to the busiest route when its queue is much larger; Preserve the existing even-headway terminal hold and 45 s train dwell.
